`2015 – 2018`

**Topics:** process safety · risk assessment · management systems

**My contributions:** project management, safety workshops, study development, training

**Skills used:** HAZOP, HAZID, SMP, QRA, ERP, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001

## Overview

Oil and gas facilities need systematic studies to identify hazards and plan for emergencies. As Risk / Safety and Environmental Consultant, I worked with clients on onshore and offshore facilities in Vietnam.

## My role

- Acted as **Project Manager**, liaising with clients and running safety workshops
- Contributed to HAZOP, HAZID, SMP, QRA and ERP studies
- Advised clients on ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 requirements and implementation
- Delivered basic Risk Assessment training as course trainer
